end_paradox_reboot.title: Ending 1: The Infinite Loop Reboot
end_paradox_reboot.epilogue: You present the Quantum Dog Paradox. Steam shoots from EXCUSE-BOT's auditory sensors. With a musical chime, it reboots into 'Lenient Mode' and approves every excuse in the city.

end_honest_day.title: Ending 2: The Day of Unvarnished Truth
end_honest_day.epilogue: You declare that people should simply admit: 'I just didn't want to get out of bed.' Shockingly, civic efficiency doubles as people stop making excuses altogether.
